pointer-only-handlers-no-keyboard-path: A control built from a plain div, span, or image fires only on mouse or touch events with no keyboard handler, so keyboard-only users can never reach or trigger it.
emulated-control-focusable-but-not-activ: A fake button or link you can Tab to but that ignores Enter or Space (or only one of them), so it looks operable yet does nothing for keyboard users.
drag-drop-endpoint-vs-path-exception-and: A drag-and-drop action like reordering a list or dropping a file has no keyboard alternative, locking out keyboard users from a task mouse users can do.
hover-pointer-only-revealed-essential-co: Menus, tooltips, or row buttons appear only on mouse hover and never on keyboard focus, hiding essential information or the only way to act from keyboard users.
focus-removed-on-receipt: A script yanks focus away the instant a control receives it, so even though you can Tab to the control, focus never stays long enough for you to use it.
keystroke-timing-dependence: A control only works if you hold a key down, press keys within a tight window, or type at a set speed, which many keyboard users cannot reliably do.
